count_finding.note: The compression filter removes 64-78% of channel breaks, so the precondition is neither decorative nor fatal and the material-difference claim against the frozen 20-bar-Donchian half is substantive. But the intake needs TWO symbols at >= 50 scored trades and only BTCUSD reaches it, so POSITIVE was out of reach before any control ran and long before any percentile existed.

control.construction: same-asset directed, whole-bar shuffle and re-base
control.prediction_made_before_the_run: EDGE.md §34d at 0a07162 predicted ELEVATED RISK of clause (a) failing in the POSITIVE direction, because this is the first high/low trigger since slice 46 and it also reads the ATR the barrier uses to size its stop.
control.prediction_note: All three z values came back NEGATIVE (-1.483 / -1.158 / -0.443). There is no upward bias here at all. The standing hypothesis in docs/RESEARCH_HOLD.md — that the directed instrument's bias tracks how directly the trigger reads the geometry the barrier prices its stops from — is MATERIALLY WEAKENED by this. One candidate distinction exists (slice 46's biased trigger was a FADE; this is a CONTINUATION), but it is offered after the fact and is recorded as speculation, not adopted as a refinement.
control.invalid_cause: ETHUSDT and SOLUSDT failed on INCOMPLETES (11.5% and 5.5% against a 5.0% bar), the sparse-sample problem their 23 and 35 real entries predict; ETHUSDT also failed the KS clause at p = 0.0137. SOLUSDT missed by 0.5 percentage points and the bar is the bar. This is NOT the slice-49 or slice-50 construction mismatch: the null found and scheduled setups on both symbols, there were simply too few.

ETHUSDT.why: control INVALID, and 23 entries is below the >= 50 gate

SOLUSDT.why: control INVALID, and 35 entries is below the >= 50 gate

edge_verdict_note: INCONCLUSIVE under the intake's multi-symbol rule, which needs two symbols at >= 50 scored trades. BTCUSD alone was measurable and it read ABSENT (69.1 / 73.5 vs 95.0 on 76 trades under a VALID control) — a trustworthy single-symbol refusal that the family rule correctly refuses to generalise. The same shape as post_shock_fade_v1 in slice 43.
positive_rule: control_validated on each symbol claimed AND at least two of {BTCUSD, ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT} with >= 50 scored trades AND those symbols each at M1 >= 95 and M2 >= 95
